L10: Reset behavior verification.
L10: Register access (read/write to all fields; reserved-bit behavior).
L10: Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes.
L10: Error and fault condition handling.
L10: Back-to-back / sustained operation.
L16: Four mandatory dedicated TAP pins: TCK, TMS, TDI, TDO.
L16: 16-state TAP controller FSM exactly per IEEE 1149.1 Figure 3-3 transition diagram.
L16: TMS and TDI sampled on the rising edge of TCK; TDO updated on the falling edge of TCK.
L16: Mandatory instructions implemented: BYPASS, EXTEST, SAMPLE/PRELOAD.
L16: Bypass register exactly 1 bit wide; loads 0 in CaptureDR.
L16: Boundary-Scan Register (BSR) with one boundary-scan cell (BSC) per external I/O pin.
L16: Instruction Register (IR) ≥ 2 bits wide; CaptureIR loads b...b01 (LSB pair '01').
L16: BYPASS opcode is all-1s (e.g. 11, 1111) — reserved so pulled-up TDI defaults to BYPASS.
L16: TestLogicReset disables all test logic so the device runs normally.
L16: TMS=1 for 5 consecutive TCK rising edges unconditionally reaches TestLogicReset from any state.
L16: Post-reset default instruction = IDCODE (if Device ID register implemented) else BYPASS.
L16: TDO is 3-state, active only in ShiftIR and ShiftDR.
L16: Daisy-chain support: TDO_n → TDI_(n+1); shared TCK + TMS in parallel.
